title: Max's Miraculous Recovery
story: Max came to us unable to walk after a severe accident. Through dedicated physiotherapy, surgery, and lots of love, he's now running and playing again. His owner says, "Dr. Deepa gave us our Max back!"

title: Whiskers' Second Chance
story: Found abandoned and malnourished, Whiskers was brought to our clinic in critical condition. After weeks of intensive care and nutrition therapy, she transformed into a healthy, playful cat and found her forever home.

title: Rocky's Emergency Rescue
story: Rocky was rushed to our clinic late at night with severe poisoning. Our emergency team worked through the night to save him. Today, Rocky is healthy and his family is forever grateful for our 24/7 care.

title: Luna's Diabetes Journey
story: Diagnosed with diabetes, Luna needed careful management. With our guidance on diet, insulin therapy, and regular monitoring, she's living a happy, active life. Her owner calls us "Luna's guardian angels."

title: Buddy's Healthy Life
story: Buddy has been our patient since he was a puppy. Through regular checkups, vaccinations, and preventive care, he's now a healthy senior dog enjoying his golden years. Prevention is the best medicine!

title: Mittens' Tumor Removal
story: When Mittens was diagnosed with a tumor, her family was devastated. Our surgical team successfully removed it, and after careful post-op care, Mittens is cancer-free and back to her playful self!
